visualReview.scope: Current source presentation; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 24 current portable/shared frames in a labeled contact sheet, including the refreshed daylight-reflection turntables. The corrected bottom pattern follows the conical surface without fan chords cutting into it. Distinct polished and bead-blasted finishes, base grating and 11884 physical tip perforations are visible. The source contains no bitmap textures.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: 4 shared graphs loaded, actual rendered geometry checked, and unload passed. Reflection-enabled capture preserves metallic materials. This is isolated fixture review, not site approval.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID OSM way 96578181 supports the center. Its 2.2 m footprint and 121.2 m height differ from the published 3 m base and 120 m height; the original published dimensions are retained. Ground datum, precise pedestal bounds, stencil azimuth, bollard arrangement and current site fit remain pending. No placement activated.

fidelityReview.notes: Maximum fidelity remains pending: the unique base stencil and its azimuth, eight fabrication frusta and joints, exact hole layout, maintenance fittings, current bollards and night illumination. The core-strata pattern and perforation row layout are original approximations with published dimensions/counts; they are not fabrication drawings.
